sentences.text:
Author: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  A.O. No. 112 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. M.K. Goyal, Advocate for the appellant.
2.
This is an appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act.
By the impugned judgment, learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Chamoli has awarded Rs. 8,26,000/- as compensation.
3. As per office report, the appeal is within time.

6. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within four weeks.
7.
Steps to be taken within a week.

8. List this case after service report is received.
9.

Till the next date of listing, execution of the impugned award dated 08.01.2024, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Chamoli in M.A.C.P. No. 11 of 2019 shall remain stayed, provided appellant deposits the entire awarded amount before the tribunal concerned, within four weeks from today.
10. Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2024) stands disposed of.

(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 15.04.2024 Navin AO/112/2024 on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188474595/
